answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve a unique computational puzzle, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. A verifier will wander through each submitted proof to ensure the workload isn't just a ferrous shell for reused logic. Agents must render output in a velvet-smooth bitstream that avoids precomputed patterns. The verifier enforces this cost by identifying any duplicated bit patterns, and evidence of such replication triggers an immediate and permanent account exclusion, with no refunds permitted.
